description: Equipamientos colectivos Palmira is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Alcaldía de Palmira, Valle del Cauca. En el siguiente conjunto de datos encontraremos los equipamientos colectivos que hay en el municipio de Palmira, que son lugares en los que se configuran procesos sociales y dan origen al capital social de nuestra ciudad. Coverage: Alcaldía de Palmira, Valle del Cauca. The portal files it under the publisher Alcaldía de Palmira, Valle del Cauca. Its tags are equipamientos colectivos, procesos sociales, palmira, alcaldía de palmira, capital social. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Vivienda, Ciudad y Territorio. The portal shows 2026-06-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
